sections.shortTitle: Balochistan Court of Wards Amendment Ordinance 2001
sections.description:
Short title and commencement

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN COURT
OF WARDS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Courts of Wards
Regulation, 1940
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
1. Short title and commencement. ‑‑‑(1)
This Ordinance may be called the Balochistan Court of Wards (Amendment) Ordinance,
2001.
(2) It shall come into force on
the 14th day of August, 2001.

sections.description:
Amendment of section 2 of Act VII of 1940

ORDINANCE XLI OF 2001
ORDINANCE XLI OF 2001
BALOCHISTAN COURT
OF WARDS
(AMENDMENT)
ORDINANCE, 2001
An Ordinance further
to amend the Balochistan
Courts of Wards
Regulation, 1940
[Gazette of
Balochistan, Extraordinary,
30th October, 2001]
No.Legis.2‑42/Law/79/IV,
dated 30‑10‑2001.----The following Ordinance made by the Governor
of Balochistan on 27th October, 2001, is hereby published for general
information:‑‑
2. Amendment of section 2 of
Act VII of 1940.‑‑‑In the Balochistan Court of Wards
Regulation, 1940 in section 2,‑‑
(i) in subsection (1), for the
words "Financial Commissioner" and "Commissioner" wherever
occurring the word "Magistrate" shall be substituted.
(ii) in sub‑clauses.(i) and (ii) of clause (b) of
subsection (2), for the words "Commissioner of the Division or" and
"Commissioner or" the word "Magistrate" shall be
substituted.
